thread:
Jamie: Quick proposal — standardize the smoke-harness pass/fail conventions for new model bring-ups. Posting concrete thresholds + rollout policy. PTAL @Eva @Sam :eyes:

Eva: Nice. Couple of concrete recs up front:
- Prompt set: 500 examples stratified across top intents and edge categories.
- Metric suite: primary task metric (accuracy/ROUGE/etc.), embedding-sim (cosine), hallucination rate (manual labels on safety subset), and token-cost delta.
- Pass criteria (default): primary metric delta <= 1.5% relative, embedding-sim drop <= 0.02, hallucination <= 2% on safety suite, token-cost delta <= +10%.

Sam: Add infra SLOs too: p50/p95 latency measured on hosted L1 under smoke traffic. Hard fail if p95 > 400ms. Soft warn if p95 in (250,400]. Also require quantized variant smoke run.

Jamie: Proposed gate semantics (3 tiers):
- BLOCK (hard fail): safety fail OR primary metric drop > 3% OR p95 latency > 400ms OR hallucination > 5%.
- WARN (soft fail): primary delta in (1.5%,3%] OR cost +10–20% OR embedding-sim drop > 0.02. Requires mitigation plan + PM/ML-owner signoff before rollout.
- OBSERVE (accept with monitoring): minor regressions within pass criteria but with increased variance; proceed with 10% canary + 24h sentry.

Maria: For WARN -> allow a canary with automatic rollback hooks. PM signoff required to proceed. Also require a documented rollout plan and rollback criteria attached to the intake ticket.

Eva: Example eval command we should standardize in onboarding docs:
```
# run smoke harness on both fp16 and int8
eval-harness run --model mymodel:v1 --suite smoke-core --samples 500 --quantized both --record --out runs/mymodel.smoke.json
```
Also: include `--seed` and `--trace` flags for reproducibility/tracing.

Jamie: Artifacts required on intake ticket (must be attached): `prompt_set.csv`, `runs/<model>.smoke.json`, `diff_report.pdf` (auto-gen with selected plots), `rollout-plan.md`, `rollback-criteria.md`. No ticket -> no rollout.

Sam: Ops note — add automatic guard in deployment pipeline that checks `runs/*` for BLOCK signals and prevents canary from starting. eval-bot can POST results to the pipeline.

eval-bot: nightly-sentry scheduled — will alert on any WARN/BLOCK conditions during 24h canary and trigger `rollback` label if BLOCK detected.

Jamie: OK I'll update the onboarding checklist and create a template PR for the intake ticket. Plan: publish in docs by EOD Friday. Any objections?

Eva: fine by me :thumbsup:
Maria: +1, add PM approval step to template.
Sam: sounds good. I'll add the pipeline check.

Jamie: thanks all — i'll post the PR link when done.
